caption: The drawing depicts a pair of socks, with one sock laid flat and fully visible and the other partially overlapped behind it. Both socks are an off-white or cream color. The sock in the foreground features a detailed pattern of geometric and botanical shapes, rendered in fine white or light gray lines that create a lattice design with stylized leaves and small triangle motifs. The background sock is mostly plain except for two thin, horizontal reddish-orange stripes near the top edge. The composition is set against a grayish background framed by a lighter beige border, with the socks placed centrally within the image.
title: Stockings
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
